messages:
morgan: FYI postmortem follow-up — the last cross-region spike looks like a DNS throttling interaction + LB sticky-route amplification. I sketched a pair-based action plan (short-term mitigation + long-term fix) below. Can owners volunteer? :clipboard:

jamal: I can take short-term mitigation work (rate-limiter tuning + probe cadence). ETA 48h.

rachel: I'll own the long-term fix (routing decision debounce + sticky route audit). Planning to scope with infra next week.

miguel: Quick note — we saw TTL weirdness from the secondary resolver cluster. I have logs and a packet capture. Dropping sample here:

```
# tcpdump -n -s0 -w /tmp/dns-spike.pcap port 53 and host 10.23.45.67
17:12:03.123456 IP 10.23.45.67.53 > 10.0.0.1.49786: UDP, length 512
... repeated retries, SERVFAIL spikes around 17:12:04-17:12:08
```

jamal: thanks miguel — that pcap helps. For short-term I'll: 1) bump probe interval to 5s -> 1s (for affected region only) 2) add a soft backoff on LB sticky affinity TTL when resolver errors observed 3) open a throttling rule with provider to relax RPS cap for ~72h.

rachel: long-term items I'm proposing: - debounce routing weight changes so we don't oscillate on transient probe signals - add a deterministic fallback when DNS returns SERVFAIL to prefer healthy egress region - scheduled audit for sticky-route config across all routes (owner: rachel)

dns-oncall-bot: probe-results: region-us-west-2: DNS query error rate elevated from 0.2% -> 4.8% at 2026-03-15T17:12Z. Rolling average shows 90th percentile spike in RTTs.

morgan: pairing format (action-pairs): each row = short-term mitigation | long-term fix | owner | ETA. Example I pasted to keep simple:

- "increase probe freq (us-west-2)" | "debounce routing weight changes" | jamal/rachel | short: 48h, long: 2w
- "soft LB affinity TTL on resolver error" | "audit sticky-route config + refactor affinity logic" | jamal/rachel | short: 24h, long: 3w
- "request provider throttle lift (72h)" | "move critical routes to dedicated pool" | jamal/infra | short: 72h, long: 4w

miguel: adding an instrumentation item: record DNS resolver error type with request-level trace_id so we can correlate app errors to specific upstreams. I can do that in the runtime in ~1w.

rachel: can we add a temporary alert on "resolver SERVFAIL rate > 1% for 5m" to reduce time-to-detect? If yes, assign to oncall to monitor.

morgan: yes — jamal can add the alert. jamal? :eyes:

jamal: will add alert, will also push the probe freq change and soft affinity. I'll post PRs/links here when ready.

morgan: great. Action summary (I'll track in the postmortem follow-up board):
- jamal: short-term probe+affinity+alert deploy (ETA 48h)
- rachel: sticky-route audit + debounce design (ETA 2w)
- miguel: packet capture + trace_id instrumentation proposal (ETA 1w)
- infra: provider throttle lift request + move plan (coord by jamal, ETA short 72h, long 4w)

morgan: tagging owners in issue tracker now. If anything slips, ping me. I'll run a quick sync tomorrow 10:30 PT. :calendar:

rachel: sounds good — I'll add the audit checklist to the issue and start the design doc.

jamal: PRs posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1292. Short-term probe change rolled in canary at 2026-03-16T02:10Z.

miguel: uploaded /tmp/dns-spike.pcap to the incident folder: s3://redwood-incidents/3123456789/dns-spike.pcap

morgan: thanks all. we'll validate metrics after 24h and decide whether to extend the throttle lift or rollback.
